            "deliverable": {"types": ["BUNDLE"], "data": {}},
            "minimum_purchase_quantity": 1,
            "maximum_purchase_quantity": 10,
            "payment_methods": ["PAYPAL"]
        }
    ],
    bundle_items=[{"product_variant_id": 4321, "quantity": 2}]
)

import os
from sellapp_sdk import SellAppClient

client = SellAppClient(base_url=os.environ["SELLAPP_API_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["SELLAPP_API_KEY"], store=os.environ["SELLAPP_STORE"])

result = client.add_ons.create(
    title="Priority support",
    description="Personal help with your design kit",
    visibility="PUBLIC",
    is_draft=False,
    parent_product_ids=[120],
    variant={
        "title": "Standard",
        "description": "The complete design kit",
        "pricing": {"price": {"price": 1999, "currency": "USD"}, "humble": False},
        "deliverable": {
            "types": ["MANUAL"],
            "data": {"comment": "Your kit will be delivered shortly."}
        },
        "minimum_purchase_quantity": 1,
        "maximum_purchase_quantity": 10,
        "payment_methods": ["PAYPAL"]
    }
)
print(result)
